cells.A: BMDC REGISTRATION QUALIFYING EXAMINATION (RQE) & ELIGIBILITY CERTIFICATE FACT-CHECK (BANGLADESH)
Critical Regulatory Verification for EduExpress International — Separating Agency Rumors from Legal BMDC Requirements
1. FACT-CHECK ON 'NO PRE-DEPARTURE BMDC ELIGIBILITY CERTIFICATE NEEDED' (CRITICAL WARNING FOR EDUEXPRESS)

cells.B: Why Sub-Agents Claim 'It Is Not Needed'
cells.C: The Actual Legal Reality at BMDC (Dhaka)

cells.B: Chinese universities and the Chinese Embassy in Dhaka do NOT ask for a BMDC Eligibility Certificate to issue an Offer Letter, JW202, or X1 Student Visa. Therefore, students CAN fly to China without it.
cells.C: While you can fly to China without it, the official BMDC Registration Qualifying Examination (RQE) Application Form explicitly lists Item 6: 'Eligibility Certificate Sl. No. & Date of Issue' and Item 12(c): 'Original Eligibility Certificate from BM&DC with photocopy'.
cells.D: Never confuse 'not needed for China Visa' with 'not needed for BMDC Doctor Registration'.

cells.A: When the Eligibility Certificate is Checked
cells.B: Some students apply for the BMDC Eligibility Certificate AFTER returning to Bangladesh or during a vacation by paying a late/processing fee, leading to the rumor that pre-departure check doesn't matter.
cells.C: Even if a student obtains the Eligibility Certificate later, BMDC checks their original SSC & HSC marksheets against the DGHS/BMDC eligibility criteria of their admission year (Combined GPA, Biology GPA >= 3.50, and study gap limit).
cells.D: If a student's HSC Biology GPA is < 3.50 or their SSC+HSC GPA is below the BMDC minimum, they will NEVER get the Eligibility Certificate—neither before departure nor after 6 years!

cells.B: Unscrupulous agencies tell students with GPA 6.0 or Biology GPA 2.5 that 'BMDC Eligibility Certificate is abolished' just to collect service charges.
cells.C: To be eligible for BMDC RQE after graduating abroad, a Bangladeshi student MUST meet the national minimum (SSC+HSC Combined GPA >= 7.00–8.00, individual GPA >= 3.50, HSC Biology GPA >= 3.50, max 1–2 yr gap). Students who want to practice in Bangladesh MUST apply for the Eligibility Certificate at BMDC Bijoy Nagar (Fee: ~1,000 BDT).
cells.D: For students who do NOT meet BMDC GPA criteria: either have parents sign a 'Non-BMDC Practice Waiver' (if they plan to settle abroad/do MPH) OR enroll them in 4-Yr Pharmacy / Biotechnology instead of MBBS!

cells.A: 2. COMPLETE GUIDE TO BMDC REGISTRATION QUALIFYING EXAMINATION (RQE) FOR CHINA MBBS GRADUATES

cells.B: Mandatory Licensing Exam for all Foreign Medical (MBBS) & Dental (BDS) Graduates
cells.C: Under the Bangladesh Medical and Dental Council Act (2010), no Bangladeshi citizen who graduated with an MBBS/BDS degree outside Bangladesh can practice medicine or do a registered internship in Bangladesh without passing the RQE.
cells.D: Explain RQE clearly during counseling so parents trust EduExpress's transparency.

cells.B: Held Twice a Year (Typically April/May and October/November)
cells.C: BMDC publishes notices on www.bmdc.org.bd twice annually. Document verification takes place physically at BMDC Office (203 Shaheed Syed Nazrul Islam Sarani, Bijoy Nagar, Dhaka).
cells.D: Remind graduating batches 3 months before April and October sessions.

cells.B: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) | Duration: ~1.5 to 2 Hours
cells.C: Core Subjects Tested: Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Physiology, Anatomy, Pathology, Pharmacology, and Microbiology (aligned with the standard Bangladesh Final Prof MBBS curriculum).
cells.D: Provide Bangladeshi MBBS books/guidelines to China MBBS students starting from Year 4.

cells.B: Minimum Passing Mark: 40% to 50% (Per BMDC Exam Committee benchmark; no negative marking in standard sessions)
cells.C: If a candidate does not pass on the first attempt, they are allowed to re-appear in subsequent RQE sessions by paying the re-examination fee (5,000 BDT).
cells.D: Graduates from the 45 MOE English-medium universities have a significantly higher pass rate than bilingual/non-MOE schools.

cells.A: Mandatory Attestation & Document Checklist for RQE
cells.B: 13-Point Mandatory Document Dossier required by BMDC Registrar
cells.C:
1. Original MBBS Degree & Transcripts (Chinese & English)
2. Attestation by Bangladesh Embassy in Beijing + Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) in Dhaka
3. Downloaded MOE List proof showing the university name
4. Original Passport with all 5-6 years of China Visa & Entry-Exit stamps (proving physical in-person study)
5. Original SSC & HSC Certificates + BMDC Eligibility Certificate
6. Processing Fee: 8,000 BDT Pay Order.
cells.D: Warn students in China NEVER to lose their old passports containing their X1/Residence Permit visas—BMDC checks physical stay in China!

cells.B: Temporary Registration -> 1-Year Internship -> Full BMDC Registration
cells.C:
1. If the student completed their 1-year internship in China AND passes RQE: BMDC evaluates clinical logs (may require 6–12 months acclimatization internship in BD).
2. If the student returns to BD after 5 years of theory: They sit for RQE, get Temporary Registration, complete 1-year internship at a BMDC-approved hospital in Bangladesh, and then receive Full BMDC Registration.
cells.D: Most Bangladeshi students prefer doing the 6th-year internship in Bangladesh or in top Chinese affiliated hospitals after clearing HSK-4.

cells.A: 3. MEDICAL FOUNDATION / PRE-MEDICAL / 6-MONTH MARCH PREPARATORY PROGRAMS EXPLAINED

cells.C:
1. Bangladeshi HSC students who missed the September intake and don't want to waste a full year at home.
2. Students who are 17 years old in March and will turn 18 by September.
3. Students needing preparation for the mandatory CSCA (Math, Physics, Chemistry) & English interview.
cells.D: Student flies to China in March on an X1/X2 study visa, studies Medical English, Basic Chinese (HSK 1-2), Physics, Chemistry & Biology for 1 semester, and transitions directly into the 6-Year English MBBS in September.
